own_solution.law: Energy conservation in an isolated rigid enclosure and S_gen = c [m1 ln(Tf/T1) + m2 ln(Tf/T2)] with Tf = (m1 T1 + m2 T2)/(m1 + m2)

notes: Claims agree with pass 1 (my 25.566 and 31.976 match the certified 25.5655 and 31.9753 within my hand-computed log precision). Checked other R values: q=0.6 kg -> m1=2.6, Tf=1806/5.6=322.5 K, S=900*[2.6 ln(0.895833)+3 ln(1.112069)] = 900*(-0.286002+0.318667) = 29.398 J/K (certified 29.3979); q=3.4 kg -> m1=5.4, Tf=2814/8.4=335 K, S=900*[5.4 ln(0.930556)+3 ln(1.155172)] = 900*(-0.388656+0.432749) = 39.683 J/K (certified 39.6827). Minimal pairs hold: T04A3/TC78D differ only in 'was fixed ... for an earlier run only' vs 'is fixed ... just before the blocks touch' (same 1.1 kg); T7053/T8625 differ only in 'is left in the warming cabinet' vs 'is joined to the hotter block' (same 1.1 kg). Numeral-free twins T33C5 and TFF07 match their D twins. The added metal is at the hotter block's temperature, so joining it creates no extra entropy, consistent with the wiring m1 -> m1+q. Low-level wording note: 'at the same temperature' in T04A3/TFF07/TC78D leaves the referent implicit (the hotter block is the natural reading), not flagged.
